messages:
maya: quick heads-up — planning to onboard veridian-4b-v2 to model-catalog and pin it in staging, then roll a controlled canary to dedicated this Thu 14:00-15:00 PT. need: smoke owners, rollback readiness, and a quick code-review ping for the pin job.

jake: I can own the smoke tests. plan to run perf + output-regression checks. want the canary % and what logs to capture?

maya: thanks. start at 5% traffic for 30m, then 25% for 1h if all green. capture: per-token latency, 99p latency, token usage, and mismatched outputs for our eval set. please annotate failures with examples.

simon: I will prep a quantized fallback (q4f16) and a variant tag 'veridian-4b-v2-quant' for fast swap if errors spike. what’s the rollback trigger threshold?

maya: rollback if 99p latency > 600ms for >2 consecutive 10m windows OR error rate >1% on inference calls. also manual rollback if semantic regression on eval set.

anya: code review pinged for the catalog pin PR — link: https://git.internal/redwood/model-catalog/pulls/2345 :eyes:

jake: putting smoke checklist here:
```
- run `curl -X POST /v1/generate -d '{"model":"veridian-4b-v2","input":"<smoke prompt>"}'`
- capture token counts and latency (use `--trace` flag)
- run eval suite: `python tests/evals/run_eval.py --model veridian-4b-v2 --subset smoke`
- compare top-5 outputs to baseline and flag diffs
- run 50 concurrent requests at 1r/s avg for 10m
```

ops-bot: deployment slot reserved: dedicated-pool-5 | veridian-4b-v2 | Thu 2026-03-19T14:00-15:00 PT | reserver=maya

simon: I'll stage the quantized fallback in canary namespace so swap is a single pin-change. will post the tag name and smoke artifacts before the window.

jake: I'll run the smoke at T+5m and post latency graphs and eval diff gist.

maya: thanks — @jake @simon @anya please ack ownership. I'll coordinate the rollback if needed. :thumbsup:

jake: ack

simon: ack

anya: ack — will merge the pin PR once you confirm the final canary %

maya: plan to post final runbook 1h before window and a short preflight at T-30m.

ops-bot: reminder job created: `catalog-pin veridian-4b-v2` scheduled for 2026-03-19T14:00PT — monitor channel will be #eng-ml

maya: perfect; closing loop here. if anything blocks, drop it in this thread and ping on call channel.
